tools.name: trackingmore_list_couriers
tools.description: List the carriers TrackingMore supports with their courier_code, name, country, website, phone and the extra fields some of them need. The full list is long (1,000+), so filter with `search` (matches name or code) and/or `country`; replies hold at most `limit` couriers. GET /couriers/all.

tools.name: trackingmore_detect_courier
tools.description: Find which couriers a tracking number most likely belongs to (returns matching courier codes and names). Use the code with trackingmore_create_tracking. Does not create anything. POST /couriers/detect.

tools.name: trackingmore_list_trackings

tools.description: WRITE: register ONE shipment so TrackingMore starts tracking it. tools.name: trackingmore_update_tracking
tools.description: WRITE: change the descriptive fields of a registered tracking (order number, customer name/email, title, note, label, language, postal code, ship date ...). Only the fields you pass change; the tracking number and courier cannot be changed here. PUT /trackings/update/{id}.

tools.name: trackingmore_delete_tracking
tools.description: WRITE (destructive): permanently remove one tracking from the TrackingMore account by id. Its checkpoint history is lost; registering the shipment again later uses another credit. Confirm with the user first. DELETE /trackings/delete/{id}.
